def activate(self, widget=None, resort=True):
    songs = self._get_playlist_songs()

    text = self.get_filter_text()
    if text:  # Assuming we want to filter only if there's text
        self._query = None  # Clear the query dependency
        songs = self._query.filter(songs) if self._query else songs
    GLib.idle_add(self.songs_selected, songs, resort)
